title: Episode 1
overview: Caiman and Nikaido hunt for the sorcerer who cursed him with a lizard's head, while Fujita returns to the Hole to avenge Matsumura's death.

title: Episode 2
overview: "Cleaners" Shin and Noi get to work in the Hole. Meanwhile, Caiman and Nikaido search for a sorcerer who uses acupuncture to change faces.

title: Episode 3
overview: Caiman and Nikaido take part in the annual Night of the Living Dead. But before they can finish their mission, Shin and Noi show up to finish them.

title: Episode 4
overview: En consults his comrade Turkey, whose magical dolls may identify the "lizard guy." Caiman and Nikaido visit Kasukabe, a professor studying sorcerers.

title: Episode 5
overview: In the sorcerers' world, Caiman and Nikaido locate a man with cross eyes, but the trail goes cold when Shin and Noi show up on a mission.

title: Episode 6
overview: En's mushroom magic gravely injures Nikaido when she infiltrates his mansion. Dr. Vaux and Professor Kasukabe tell Caiman about Shin's dark past.

title: Episode 7
overview: Plotting to avenge Matsumura, Fujita joins the Hole Peace Hospital's baseball team: their rival team has his friend's killer Caiman on the roster.

title: Episode 8
overview: Fearing for Nikaido's safety, Caiman returns to the sorcerers' world alone. The En family begins preparations for the Blue Night Party festivities.

title: Episode 9
overview: Caiman sneaks into the festival grounds in pursuit of Risu. Meanwhile, En tells Fujita the story of how Shin and Noi became partners.

title: Episode 10
overview: Nikaido dons a powerful mask to defeat her enemy, only to find the attack was a trap by En. With Tanba's help, Caiman visits one of the Cross-Eyes.

title: Episode 11
overview: As a member of the family, Nikaido learns why En needs a sorcerer who can manipulate time. Caiman disguises himself as Tanba's wife to rescue her.

title: Episode 12
overview: Caiman tries to convince Nikaido to return to the Hole with him, but her contract with En binds her. After the fight, En launches a search for her.
